readme:
# Goodreads Scraper

Read the books on public Goodreads Listopia lists. Give a list address or a list number, and the actor returns every book on it with its rank, score, votes, average rating, ratings count, series, author and cover. You can also give a tag, such as `fantasy`, and the actor finds lists for that tag. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One record per book on each list you ask for, up to 100 books per page of the list.
- Several lists in one run, and several pages per list. Set `maxItems` and the actor stops when it has that many books.
- Lists found by tag, for example the first three lists tagged `fantasy`.
- The same book on two different lists gives two records, one per list, each with its own rank and score on that list.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Books already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for books that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/goodreads-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `goodreads-scraper` to read the first 100 books of Goodreads list 50 and show me the ones rated above 4.2 with more than 100,000 ratings."

## Data extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `book_id` | `"2767052"` |
| `url` | `"https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/2767052-the-hunger-games"` |
| `title` | `"The Hunger Games"` |
| `full_title` | `"The Hunger Games (The Hunger Games, #1)"` |
| `series`, `series_number` | `"The Hunger Games"`, `"1"` |
| `author_name`, `author_url`, `author_id` | `"Suzanne Collins"`, author page address, `"153394"` |
| `is_goodreads_author` | `true` when the list marks the author as a Goodreads Author |
| `authors` | All author names shown for the book |
| `cover_image_url`, `cover_thumbnail_url` | Cover image addresses |
| `average_rating` | `4.36` |
| `ratings_count` | `10350683` |
| `list_rank` | `1` (position on the list) |
| `list_score` | `4580398` |
| `list_votes` | `46541` (people who voted for the book on this list) |
| `list_id`, `list_title`, `list_url` | The list the book was read from |
| `list_total_books`, `list_total_votes` | Size of the whole list |
| `page` | Page of the list the book was read from |
| `scraped_at` | `"2026-11-07T08:00:00Z"` |

Fields that a page does not show are returned empty (null).

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for books that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Book scraped (`book-result`) | $0.0015 per book ($1.50 per 1,000) |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved book. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `listUrls` | string[] | List addresses such as `https://www.goodreads.com/list/show/1`, or list numbers such as `50`. | list 1 when `tags` is empty |
| `tags` | string[] | Tags such as `fantasy`. The first lists of each tag are read in addition to `listUrls`. | none |
| `listsPerTag` | integer | How many lists to read for each tag. | `3` |
| `maxItems` | integer | Most books to return across all lists. 0 uses 100. | `100` |
| `maxPagesPerList` | integer | Most pages to read from each list. A page holds up to 100 books. 0 uses 5. | `5` |

## Usage examples

### Two lists, two pages each

```json
{
  "listUrls": ["https://www.goodreads.com/list/show/1", "50"],
  "maxPagesPerList": 2,
  "maxItems": 400
}
```

### Lists found by tag

```json
{
  "tags": ["fantasy", "romance"],
  "listsPerTag": 2,
  "maxPagesPerList": 1,
  "maxItems": 500
}
```

### One page of one list

```json
{
  "listUrls": ["50"],
  "maxPagesPerList": 1
}
```

## Output

Results are saved to the default dataset. Export them as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read them through the API.

Sample record:

```json
{
  "book_id": "2767052",
  "url": "https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/2767052-the-hunger-games",
  "title": "The Hunger Games",
  "series": "The Hunger Games",
  "series_number": "1",
  "author_name": "Suzanne Collins",
  "author_url": "https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/153394.Suzanne_Collins",
  "average_rating": 4.36,
  "ratings_count": 10350683,
  "list_rank": 1,
  "list_score": 4580398,
  "list_votes": 46541,
  "list_id": "1",
  "list_url": "https://www.goodreads.com/list/show/1",
  "page": 1
}
```

## Limitations

- Only public Listopia lists are read. Search results, reviews and user pages are not read.
- The list pages do not show the publication year, the page count, the genres or the description of a book. Those fields are not returned.
- Votes, scores and ratings are the numbers at the time of the run.
- A list can change between two runs. Ranks move when people vote.
- Large lists have many pages. Use `maxPagesPerList` and `maxItems` to keep a run small.
- A tag gives the lists that Goodreads shows first for it. The order is set by the site.
- If the site refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged.

## FAQ

**Which pages does it read?**
The list pages at `goodreads.com/list/show/<number>` and, for tags, the tag pages at `goodreads.com/list/tag/<tag>`.

**How many books do I get per list?**
Up to 100 per page. A list with 80,000 books has 800 pages, and you choose how many to read.

**What does a run cost?**
The start price plus the price per book, see the pricing table. A run that reads one full page costs 100 books plus the start event.

**What status does a run end with?**
The run status says how many books were delivered. If a list does not exist or is empty, the run ends normally and says so. If the site refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged.

**Can I get reviews?**
No. This actor returns the list entry of each book, not the review text.
